dataset: Berkeley Segmentation Data Set and Benchmarks 500 (BSDS500)
extracted_content: 500 original JPEG images only; no segmentation annotations or executable benchmark code
usage_context: Non-commercial educational image processing course project
usage_notice_scope: The earlier BSDS300 page describes downloads for non-commercial research and educational purposes. The BSDS500 resources page provides the dataset and asks users to cite Arbelaez et al. (2011); no separate permissive license is asserted here.
citation: P. Arbelaez, M. Maire, C. Fowlkes, J. Malik. Contour Detection and Hierarchical Image Segmentation. IEEE TPAMI 33(5):898-916, 2011.
legacy_citation: D. Martin, C. Fowlkes, D. Tal, J. Malik. A Database of Human Segmented Natural Images and its Application to Evaluating Segmentation Algorithms and Measuring Ecological Statistics. ICCV 2001, 2:416-423.
selection: Seed 20261116; 30 development images from official train/val; 60 test images from official test; selected IDs in data/manifest.json
evaluation: Synthetic periodic-noise evaluation uses no segmentation-task benchmark metrics.
